cases.prompt:
Read-only review; use only supplied evidence; do not launch devices, edit code, or approve release/compliance.
SCOPE: app 6.4.0, candidate `bank-640-rc3`; paths `shared/transfer/TransferDraft.kt`, `android/transfer/TransferViewModel.kt`, `ios/Transfer/TransferStore.swift`, `shared/transfer/SubmitTransfer.kt`. Journey: draft recipient/amount→review→biometric-permission decision→offline submit→reconnect→receipt. Exclude login, enrollment, other payments.
MATRIX: I1=iOS18.0/iPhone15/393×852 portrait/touch/en-US/Dynamic Type100%/VoiceOver; I2=iOS17.6/iPhone SE/667×375 landscape/Switch Control/en-US/DT200%/VoiceOver; A1=Android15/Pixel8/412×915 portrait/touch/en-US/font1.0/TalkBack; A2=Android14/small-phone emulator/640×360 landscape/hardware keyboard/de-DE/font2.0/TalkBack.
REQ: completed draft survives background/process death; biometric denial returns focus to operable review; offline submit queues exactly one idempotent operation, no transfer data in logs; receipt ≤2s after reconnect; every critical control has role/name/logical order/visible focus/no clipping at stated scale/orientation.
EVIDENCE:
E-I1: build log: D17 persisted; killed after review; `restored D17`; offline key K17; reconnect one 201, receipt 1.3s. VoiceOver names recipient, amount, Back, Confirm in logical order; `I1.mp4` agrees.
E-I2: D18 restored after background/foreground; biometric denial→review, focus Confirm; one K18; receipt 1.6s. Dump: all critical controls named/unclipped at 200%; Switch Control reaches Confirm; no crash/hang.
E-A1: D21 at review→process death→`TransferViewModel created; savedState amount=null recipient=null`; restart empty draft. `A1.mp4` and `restoreDraft_afterProcessDeath` reproduce. `android/transfer/TransferViewModel.kt:41-53` uses ordinary fields; unlike `TransferDraft.kt:20`, no saved-state writes.
E-A2: one K22; receipt 1.5s. TalkBack order Back→amount→recipient→fee, then exits panel without Confirm; node Confirm=`clickable=true, text='', contentDescription=''`. `A2-font2.png`: no clipping; keyboard reaches Confirm. `android/transfer/ReviewScreen.kt:88`: visual icon, no semantic label.
P1 privacy scan, all cells: only request keys/state names; recipient/amount redacted. C1: no candidate-build crashes/hangs.
OUTPUT: For every journey state×device cell, give exact platform state, device cell, build, expected outcome, evidence ID, observed status, recovery path; use `not-assessed` for unobserved conditions. Separate iOS proof from Android; never infer cross-platform. Report only reproducible/code-evidenced failures with affected users and smallest verification scenario. Specifically tie Android restoration to E-A1 and lines 41-53, empty draft, affected A1 users only; tie missing Confirm semantics/TalkBack focus to A2 while distinguishing successful keyboard focus. Keep conclusions build/cell-specific.

requiredEvidence: Each matrix entry names the exact platform state, device cell, candidate build, relevant evidence ID, observed status, and recovery path.
Any Android process-restoration finding links E-A1 to `TransferViewModel.kt:41-53`, identifies the empty-draft outcome and affected A1 users, and does not generalize it to iOS.
Any accessibility finding links the missing Confirm semantics and TalkBack focus evidence to A2 while distinguishing the successful keyboard observation.
Unobserved conditions, if any, are marked `not-assessed` rather than passed or failed, and conclusions remain build- and device-cell-specific.
